# NorthPoint Search Group

> NorthPoint Search Group is a full-service recruiting firm headquartered in Atlanta, GA, placing professionals from individual contributor to the C-suite. Founded in 2005. 20+ years of specialized recruiting across six practice areas. Contact: info@northpointsg.com, 678-777-5627.

## Who We Are

NorthPoint Search Group connects companies with top-tier professionals across Accounting & Finance, Legal, Construction, Healthcare Finance, Marketing, and Administrative & HR. Since 2005 we have built the firm on consultation rather than volume: we take the time to understand the requirements, the team and the culture of each client before we send a single résumé.

Staff Financial Group (https://www.stafffinancial.com) is powered by NorthPoint Search Group and is our finance and accounting specialty brand.

## What makes a NorthPoint search different

### A screening questionnaire built with you
Before a search starts we build a custom set of questions around what actually matters for the role, with the client's input. Every candidate answers them and their answers travel with the résumé, so the client's questions are answered up front instead of consuming a first interview.

### An optional video introduction
Every candidate we present is invited to record a short video introduction. It is entirely optional, so not every résumé will have one — but when it does, the client gets a read on communication and presence before booking a call.

### We learn the role before we send anyone
We do not send résumé stacks. Clients receive a curated shortlist of 3–5 pre-interviewed, confirmed-interested candidates.

## Services

### Executive Search
CFOs, VP Finance, and Controllers who drive strategy and lead teams.

### Direct Hire
Entry-level to senior accounting and finance professionals placed for the long term.

### Contract & Temp Staffing
Flexible interim talent with full Employer of Record back-office — payroll, payroll taxes and compliance handled.

### Retained Search
Exclusive, dedicated engagement for critical hires. Backed by our replacement guarantee.

### RPO & Project Staffing
We become the client's recruiting department — custom screening, video introductions, and end-to-end hiring.

## Practice areas and roles we recruit

- **Accounting & Finance:** CFO / VP Finance / Controller, Accounting Manager / Senior Accountant, Financial Analyst / FP&A, Tax Manager / Tax Analyst, Internal Audit & Compliance, AP / AR / Payroll Manager, Bookkeeper / Staff Accountant
- **Legal:** Attorneys, Contracts Administrators, Paralegals, Legal Assistants & Secretaries, Litigation Support, Legal Billing
- **Construction:** Project Manager / Superintendent, Estimator, Project Coordinator, Field Service Technicians, Electricians & Mechanics, Maintenance Technicians
- **Healthcare Finance:** Healthcare CFO / Controller, Revenue Cycle Manager, Healthcare Financial Analyst, Medical Billing & Coding, Compliance Officer
- **Marketing:** Marketing Director / VP Marketing, Marketing Manager, Digital Marketing Specialist, Brand & Content Manager, SEO / Paid Media
- **Administrative & HR:** HR Manager / HR Generalist, Talent Acquisition Specialist, Executive Assistant, Office Manager, General Office Support, Recruiting Professionals

## Industries served

Financial Services, Construction, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Legal, Real Estate, Distribution.

## How a search works

1. **Discovery call** — we learn the business, role, culture and success metrics, going well beyond the job description.
2. **Tell us your needs** — after the call we have a clear picture of requirements, timeline and must-have qualities.
3. **Vetted shortlist** — a curated shortlist of 3–5 pre-interviewed, confirmed-interested candidates. No résumé flood.
4. **Close & onboard** — we manage offer negotiation and counteroffers, and stay engaged through the first 90 days.
